summary: Retrieve Node fs.Stats synchronously while following symbolic links and preserving bigint/throwIfNoEntry options.

semantics.return_value: Node-compatible Stats or undefined when throwIfNoEntry:false and entry absent
semantics.bigint_option: numeric Stats fields become JS BigInt-compatible values when requested

caveats: System.IO FileInfo/DirectoryInfo do not expose the full Node Stats surface or identical timestamps/type predicates.
Filesystem timestamp precision and birthtime availability vary by OS/filesystem.

tests.name: follows symlink
tests.expected_behavior: if ln points to a regular file, isFile() is true

tests.name: missing can return undefined
tests.expected_behavior: returns JS undefined rather than throwing when the path is absent
